title: The AI Refused to Roast Him
idea: Late at night Battery asks an AI to roast him 'no mercy'; it refuses out of pity ('you've been through enough'). Kalu: that IS the roast. Battery asks it to roast his friend instead; the AI: 'He has you as a friend... that's punishment enough.' Kalu, eating popcorn: '...I like this AI.'
lines: see lines.json (captions) and tts.json (text with audio tags sent to ElevenLabs)
hooks_considered: Bro... I asked AI to roast me. And it said NO! (kept)
The AI felt sorry for me.
I got rejected by a chatbot.
Even the AI took pity on me.
pacing_brief: Hook = Battery's outraged line in the first second on a tight close with the phone glowing on his face, cut wider on 'roast', punch-in on 'NO!'. 25.2 s, 9 lines, ~15 shots, cut on every line. Two phone inserts carry the chat (blank text bars, flame icon on his message, typing dots, AI reply pops with a pity heart / a smiley) so nothing needs reading; captions only. Kalu silently shakes holding in a laugh, popcorn as the running prop. Savage twist lands on a wide two-shot, then Battery's slow betrayed turn on 'punishment', then Kalu's tiny smirk and a popcorn bite as the abrupt ending. Voices tight: atempo 1.04-1.1, caps .15-.22 s, a beat of air (.35-.45 s) before both AI replies and the last line.
